name: opencode-go-watch
description: Cloudflare Worker that semantically monitors OpenCode Go usage limits and sends rich Telegram diffs.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js test/*.test.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --target ES2023 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2023,DOM --skipLibCheck src/*.js
